# Instructions for accurately documenting company losses in a financial disclosure

1. Start with the accounting records.
2.
completion:
Check for any extra adjustments that need to be made:
   * The employee/HR (or other similar) data shouldn't be in the accounting records.
   * In cases where the accounting records are wrong, adjustments need to be made.
   * For items that are not capitalized (e.g. salaries, advertising campaigns, large payments, etc., see the guide below), losses will only be reported in the year they were incurred. In most cases this will be when the service or goods were received or a similar metric.
3. Add up the adjustments and add up the losses from the accounting records.
4. This will be the total amount of loss an entity experiences in a given year.

# Determining the amount of loss
